Per Rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual codes (84199090 / 75072000 / 83111000) and verdict is accepted_hs_corrected. Also note the address on record is 'RADAUR ROAD' (Yamunanagar, Haryana), which conflicts with the claimed state Gujarat — state should be re-verified. What is NOT proven is outbound export: no export B/L with date+destination+HS was captured, so export_status is declared_only, not confirmed. Domestic supply: no evidence found either way — status unknown, not 'none_found', because the search tooling failed rather than the evidence being absent. Recommend a follow-up pass with working search to pull GST turnover and GeM/CPPP awards before any final domestic verdict.
